title: Fruit fly (Mango, guava, avocado, banana etc.)

Header: Fruit fly (Mango, guava, avocado, banana etc.)
Bactrocera dorsalis , Bactrocera kandiensis , Bactrocera correcta , Bactrocera tau , Bactrocera zonata In Sinhala- Palathuru messa/ In Tamil- Pala ee

Prevention: Bagging of immature fruits with polythene, paper or silk clothing within one month of flowering
Expose pupae to sun by raking up soil surrounding fruit trees
Monitoring: Regular observation for adult fruit fly at fruiting stage
Observation of fallen fruits for larvae
Observe the density of adult flies caught in
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Collect infested fruits in black polythene bags, tight them up and expose to sun or bury infested fruits more than 45 cm deep in soil
Place pheromone traps at the rate of 10-12/ ha
When there is an increasing trend of trapped adult flies in
Pheromone traps, increase the number of bait spots/ ha
Direct Control (Chemical): Spot application of protein bait within one month of flowering and repeat at one week intervals. - Spray mixture:
Bait 400 ml+ Spinosad 20 ml (20:1 ratio) per 16 l water. - Apply 200- 400 ml spray mixture per spot. - 200-400 spots/ha (80-160 spots/acre)
